cfe-vx-tas-timing-not-a-fill-cached-2026.passage: On a normal Business Day, the trading hours for all types of TAS transactions in VX futures end at 3:00 p.m. Chicago time. TAS transactions in an expiring VX futures contract are not permitted during the Business Day of its final settlement date. The permissible price range for all types of TAS transactions in VX futures is from 0.50 index points below the daily settlement price to 0.50 index points above the daily settlement price. All TAS orders are required to be Day Orders, Immediate or Cancel Orders, or Fill or Kill Orders. TAS Market Orders are not permitted.
